Parnassus Investments decreased its stake in Ebay Inc. (EBAY) by 9.73% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Parnassus Investments sold 260,504 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.44% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.42 million shares of the business services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $97.29 million, down from 2.68 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Parnassus Investments who had been investing in Ebay Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $38.11 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.64% or $0.62 during the last trading session, reaching $38.34. About 6.96M shares traded. eBay Inc. (NASDAQ:EBAY) has risen 7.72% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.85% the S&P500.
